scenes.setting: The Berg household: convinced he is watched, Derrick follows the Hanged Man's recalled instructions — close the window, light a candle, and hold the bestowment ritual openly so Amon can carry the blame

scenes.setting: In the Athens-like palace, the Sun's star opens its door: the All-Black Eye goes into an iron box and through the gap with one warning — 'Do not touch the item inside.' Lose it and Mr. World must be gloriously sacrificed

Derrick opens the box a crack — a pupil-less black eye, ravings in his ears — seals it in spirituality, hides it inside his clothes and goes to watch the quarantined expedition members whisper and stand like zombies, waiting for his moment
scenes.text_anchor: It was a completely black eye without a pupil.

scenes.setting: Atop the spire: the shadow reports the bestowment ritual and the evil iron-black box, begging for action — but Colin will wait, still hoping the incomprehensible 'Amon' is the City of Silver's hidden hope against the coming apocalypse
scenes.text_anchor: “This might be our hidden hope, the hope for us in surviving the apocalypse when it comes!”
